description: One panel per NEM link AEMO reports on the DISPATCH,INTERCONNECTORRES table: flow against the static nominal envelope - drawn as the grey band from -reverse to +forward, both ratings from scrapers/links.py (docs/adr/0003) - and the dispatch engine's live EXPORTLIMIT/IMPORTLIMIT. Signed axis throughout, AEMO's MWFLOW convention: forward is positive. Generated by tools/build_interconnector_dashboard.py; edit that, not this JSON.

panels.description: QNI (Queensland‑New South Wales) (NSW1 -> QLD1): flow against the static nominal envelope of 900 MW forward / 1400 MW reverse (scrapers/links.py) and AEMO's dynamic EXPORTLIMIT/IMPORTLIMIT. The axis follows AEMO's MWFLOW sign - forward is positive - so the reverse rating plots below zero and the grey band is the range the link may carry. The limits are signed and free to run past the rating; the dispatch engine solves them per interval. Values are held between 5-minute polls, so a gap means the exporter stopped answering, not zero flow.
panels.title: NSW1-QLD1 · QNI (Queensland‑New South Wales)
